name: Disappearing Messages
description: Brings Enterprise-grade hard-delete message retention to the Team edition: set a per-channel TTL and expired messages are purged from the database.

settings_schema.header: Disappearing Messages settings. See the README for the hard-delete (D10) risks.

settings.help_text: When ON, expired messages are hard-deleted from the database (transactional purge). When OFF, the sweeper falls back to Mattermost's soft-delete.

Comma-separated Mattermost server version prefixes whose DB schema has been verified for hard purge (e.g. 10.,11.). The hard purge is skipped (fail-safe) on any other version. Edit after upgrading Mattermost.
